(2) Window is 72h: keep items published 2026-10-15T07:00 to 2026-10-18T07:00 (KST); verify each published time from the page itself. 10-18 is a Sunday in KST, so Friday 10-16 / Saturday 10-17 U.S. stories are the main fresh pool and the weekend is thin; Korean Saturday/Sunday pieces count. (4) Do NOT resubmit anything in do_not_resubmit; follow-ups only with a new launch, new data or a new decision. ChatGPT/AI-chat ads had 3 cards yesterday, so bias toward creative, retail media, measurement, brand safety, sales and Korean stories. Exact-match URLs against the ledger (norm_url drops query strings). (5) Check cross-section duplicates (agentic commerce can also land in gadgets/politics; Meta crawl terms touched politics).
